title: An agent turn survives a seat without an address and a tracy-web restart, a plan's fallback keeps the system prompt, comment write: lines and webroot reads stay inside the site, and the fleet model row keeps toolUpdate and the default retry codes
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/account-subscriptions.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/comment-fence.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/media-scan-fence.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-webroot-read/test/symlink-fence.test.mjs scripts/test/image-profile.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'a seat without a proven address runs on the deployment default and never asks the broker' passes.
'tracy-web restarting keeps a conversation without a plan on the default, and nothing else' passes.
'the Tracy AI note keeps the whole system prompt' passes.
'a person's words can never become a write: line' and 'a write: line naming a bare file allows that webroot file' pass.

'an uploads folder linked into another site lists none of that site's pictures', 'a planted symlink area never brings another site's file into tracy_find_definition' and 'a planted symlink never lists another site's extensions' pass.
'the fleet model row losing the catalogue row's toolUpdate is red' and 'a fleet retryable-code list without one of dsh's defaults is red' pass.
fence: Each test drives the mechanism itself with bad input: an unstamped prompt, a pin door that throws or answers 503 unavailable, a U+2028 before write:, a bare file name, a symlinked media root, area and config file, a fleet row missing toolUpdate or a default retry code. No model, no network, no Postgres.

tests: a seat without a proven address runs on the deployment default
tracy-web restarting keeps a conversation without a plan on the default
the Tracy AI note keeps the whole system prompt
a person's words can never become a write: line
a write: line naming a bare file allows that webroot file
an uploads folder linked into another site lists none of that site's pictures
a planted symlink area never brings another site's file into tracy_find_definition
a planted symlink never lists another site's extensions
the fleet model row losing the catalogue row
a fleet retryable-code list without one of dsh
